name: Duplicate Libraries on the Classpath
regex_pattern: duplicate ASM classes found on classpath|duplicate classes found on classpath
solution_markdown: The game was started with two versions of the same library (for example two ASM jars) on its classpath, which Fabric refuses to run with. This is a launcher problem, not a mod problem: update Agora, then launch again. If it still happens, use Repair on the loader to rebuild the launch profile.
